title: Shila Mari
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat 32b: “Rav Kahana said; some say Shila Mari.” Hyman says this should also be the reading in Gittin 58b.
In Shabbat 43b: “Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah said; Shila Mari likewise taught.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: “Shila Mari likewise taught” makes him the teacher, not the object of something taught. The proposed Gittin reading is Hyman’s correction.

The consulted Shabbat 32b explicitly names Rav Kahana with Shila Mari as an alternative; Shabbat 43b explicitly names Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah and says Shila Mari likewise taught. Hyman’s statement that Gittin 58b should read the same remains an attributed emendation. That intended Gittin witness was not matched in the bounded name routing, which does not prove its absence.
